context: A business is deciding how to engage different stakeholder groups before making a major decision.
stem: Select the most appropriate approach for a stakeholder with high power and high interest in the decision.

options.label: A
options.text: Monitor the stakeholder with minimal communication.

options.label: B
options.text: Keep the stakeholder informed, but do not seek feedback.

options.label: C
options.text: Keep the stakeholder satisfied through occasional updates.

options.label: D
options.text: Engage closely with the stakeholder and seek their views.

option_rationale: A is appropriate for stakeholders with low power and low interest, rather than high power and high interest.
B is more appropriate for stakeholders with low power but high interest.
C is more appropriate for stakeholders with high power but low interest.
D is correct because stakeholders with both high power and high interest should normally receive close engagement and opportunities to provide feedback.
